free_tier.stated: 1 GiB stored, 50,000 document reads per day, 20,000 writes per day, 20,000 deletes per day, exactly one free database per project

per_object_cap.stated: 1 GiB stored; a 1 MiB document size limit applies to the engine

retention.stated: data persists; there is no inactivity deletion on the free quota

egress.terms: 10 GiB a month of outbound data transfer is included in the free quota; beyond it the transfer is billed at the standard Cloud Firestore network rate, and reads are counted as operations against the daily quota

interface_detail: a REST and gRPC API with realtime listeners; SDKs for web, mobile and server; a GraphQL-ish query surface is not offered, the REST and gRPC APIs are
tooling: the Firebase Admin SDK; the gcloud and firebase CLIs; REST
chaining: 1 GiB of document state with client SDKs and realtime sync, which no other free tier here gives

limits.value: 50,000 document reads and 20,000 writes per day
1 GiB stored; exactly one free database per project

limits_note: a project may hold up to 100 databases, but only one is free, so multiple logical databases is a paid feature
confidence_note: the quotas page was read today and states 'exactly one free database per project'.

notes: The one-database rule is the constraint that a multi-tenant design meets first, not the 1 GiB.
